title: Grateful Dead Live at Austin Municipal Auditorium on 1971-11-15
lineage: SBD>MR>C>D>CD>EAC>SHN (patched with slightly degraded SBD, also listed with one cassette generation in the lineage)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1971 five‑piece show captured on a solid soundboard tape, highlighted by a monster Not Fade Away medley and tight Dark Star > El Paso > Jam sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a clear soundboard mix with crisp guitars and well‑balanced instruments, despite occasional vocal faintness and a few patched sections. Musically the concert is a showcase of the early‑'71 era – a five‑piece band firing on all cylinders, with Not Fade Away exploding into an extended jam, Dark Star flowing into El Paso, and standout moments like Cumberland Blues, Brokedown Palace and Jack Straw. Overall the performance is high‑energy, tight, and widely celebrated by fans.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews rate the show 4–5 stars, praising both performance and recording; only minor complaints about vocal levels and a few patched sections keep the rating just below top‑tier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp guitar and clear jam sections; vocals sometimes faint or distorted; a handful of songs patched from a noisy SBD copy, but overall mix is solid and well‑balanced.

standout_songs: Not Fade Away (medley with jam > GDTRFB > Not Fade Away)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight five‑piece ensemble with seamless transitions, especially the Dark Star → El Paso → Jam chain and the extended Not Fade Away medley; new 1971 songs like Jack Straw slot in smoothly.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar is praised as crisp, exact, with a stellar tone that shines throughout the jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh’s bass is described as thundering and powerful, often 'bombing' in the mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s rhythm work and vocals receive positive notes, especially his interplay with Garcia during the extended jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux gets high praise for sparkling, creative contributions that drive the Not Fade Away medley and overall vibe.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann never misses a beat; reviewers wish he were slightly higher in the mix but acknowledge his solid foundation.
